def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    sep = max(colors, key=lambda x: sum(all(v == x for v in row) for row in grid) + sum(all(grid[r][c] == x for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)))
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for x in cuts+[n]:
            if x > start: out.append((start,x))
            start=x+1
        return out
    rs, cs = spans(h, rows), spans(w, cols)
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    ans=[]
    for r0,r1 in rs:
        line=[]
        for c0,c1 in cs:
            count=sum(1 for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != sep)
            line.append(1 if count >= 2 else bg)
        ans.append(line)
    return ans
